protagonist.name: Maya
protagonist.description: a young scientist with short black hair, wearing a white lab coat

video_prompts.prompt: Scene: A minimalist, futuristic laboratory with soft blue LED trim on white surfaces. Maya, a young scientist with short black hair, wearing a white lab coat, stands before a large, semi-transparent holographic screen. The equation 'a1x + b1y + c1 = 0' is displayed in glowing white text. The coefficients 'a1', 'b1', and 'c1' are distinct, solid 3D objects made of polished chrome, hovering in front of the screen. Maya gestures, and a second equation, 'a2x + b2y + c2 = 0', materializes below the first, its coefficients made of brushed copper. The camera slowly dollies forward, moving past Maya to focus on the two equations. Final frame: a close-up on the two equations stacked vertically, their respective metallic coefficients clearly visible.

Scene: A dark, virtual space with a glowing grid on the floor and walls. Maya, a young scientist with short black hair, wearing a white lab coat, observes from the side. Two beams of light, one red and one blue, shoot out from projectors, representing two linear equations. The red beam represents 'x + y = 6' and the blue beam represents 'x - y = 2'. The beams travel through the 3D space and intersect at a single, bright point. A high-energy spark flashes at the intersection, and the coordinates '(4, 2)' materialize in glowing gold numbers next to it. The camera orbits around the intersection point, showing the lines meeting from multiple angles. Final frame: a direct shot of the intersecting beams, with the bright spark and coordinate numbers held in focus.

Scene: The same dark, grid-lined virtual space. Maya, a young scientist with short black hair, wearing a white lab coat, watches from a control panel. Two flat, solid planes of light, one green ('x + 2y = 4') and one orange ('2x + 4y = 10'), are generated. They are perfectly parallel, separated by a visible gap. Both planes of light extend forward into the virtual space at the same speed and angle, maintaining their parallel orientation and never converging. The gap between them remains constant as they stretch toward infinity. The camera starts between the two planes and pulls back rapidly, revealing their parallel nature. Final frame: a wide shot showing the two parallel planes of light stretching into the distance, emphasizing they will never meet.

Scene: Maya's lab, with bright, focused overhead lighting on a mechanical workbench. Maya, a young scientist with short black hair, wearing a white lab coat, is assembling a device. On the bench are two interlocking puzzles. A blue metal frame is labeled 'x = 7 - y'. A larger red metal structure, labeled 'x - y = 1', has a distinct 'x'-shaped slot. A robotic arm picks up the blue frame. It rotates and inserts the frame into the 'x'-slot on the red puzzle. A click is heard as the pieces lock. The red puzzle reconfigures, showing '(7 - y) - y = 1'. Gears turn, isolating a glowing 'y=3' component. A macro lens follows the arm, then zooms on the click. Final frame: a top-down view of the solved puzzle, showing illuminated 'y=3' and 'x=4' components.

Scene: A vast, empty, white room. Maya, a young scientist with short black hair, wearing a white lab coat, stands in the center. A single, shimmering, translucent plane representing 'x + y = 10' materializes, extending infinitely. Countless points of light, representing infinite solutions, sparkle on its surface. Maya raises her hand, and a second translucent plane, 'x - y = 2', slices through the first at an angle. The planes intersect, creating a single, glowing line of light. All points of light on both planes vanish, except for one intensely bright point where the line of intersection is. The camera cranes down, following the line of intersection. Final frame: a tight close-up on the single, brilliant point of light, representing the unique solution.
